description: Update blueprint sections with actual implementation data. Sends full top-level sections that are shallow-merged into the existing blueprint. Creates a version snapshot before mutation and propagates staleness to business case and implementation plan. Use this when the implementation diverges from the original recommendation.

customerOrgId.description: Customer organization ID (UUID). Required for partner users accessing a customer org.

sections.description: Top-level sections to merge. Common keys: enhancedDigitalTeam, phases, executiveSummary, executiveSummaryDetails, platformRecommendation, agenticPattern, riskAssessment, successCriteria, feasibilityIndicators, laborAnalysis, title, blueprintTitle, roiBaseline, howItWorks, teams, kpis, digitalTeam, implementation, dataProvenance, architectureRationale, integrationGaps, customTables. Additional keys are accepted and preserved.

name: update_blueprint
